what_it_does: When AI training jobs fail mid-run (crashes, overheating), work is lost and must restart. This paper analyzed 4 million real training jobs across two large GPU clusters over 11 months to understand failure patterns. They found that failure frequency depends heavily on job size—bigger jobs fail more often. Using this data, they built a formula (Effective Training Time Ratio) that predicts how much real progress a training job actually makes after accounting for failures and restarts. This lets teams decide smarter checkpoint strategies: save work more or less frequently depending on failure patterns.
